code: import axios from"axios";const api=axios.create({baseURL:process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL,timeout:8000,headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}});api.interceptors.request.use(config=>{const token=localStorage.getItem("token");if(token){config.headers.Authorization=`Bearer ${token}`;}return config;});api.interceptors.response.use(response=>response,async error=>{const config=error.config;if(!config||config.__retry){throw error;}config.__retry=true;return api(config);});export default api;
